svg.title: Knee pain: after trauma the timing of the swelling sorts the injury; without trauma the site of the pain separates patellofemoral pain syndrome and knee bursitis in front, iliotibial band friction syndrome laterally and a popliteal cyst behind; each column gives presentation, workup and treatment; knee injections are compared in a panel

svg.text: Knee pain: was there TRAUMA? If not, WHERE does it hurt?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: TRAUMA, swelling within 6 h: anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) tear, fracture, patellar dislocation, large chondral injury

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: TRAUMA, swelling after 6 h: meniscal injury, posterior cruciate (PCL) injury, high-grade medial collateral (MCL) sprain, arthritis
